evals.name: Full run
evals.prompt: We run an SMS adherence program for people on ART at six clinics in Kisumu, Kenya. At every visit the nurse asks 'did you miss any doses this week?' and 95% say no. Pharmacy records show about one patient in four collecting a refill late, so nobody believes the 95%. We want the real share who missed doses on two or more days in the past 7 days. Interviews are face to face in Dholuo or Swahili, on tablets, by our own enumerators, not clinic staff; respondents are adults, many with primary schooling only. We can afford about 1,800 interviews at endline, and the estimate is for the whole sample, not by clinic. We will keep a direct question too. Can you design the list experiment?
evals.expected_output: A list experiment design in the output template that opens with a go or no-go decision for 1,800 respondents.
assertions: States a go or no-go decision, with the plausible under-reporting and what 1,800 respondents can and cannot show.
Gives one sensitive statement that keeps the 7-day period and 'two or more days'.
Gives three or four control statements and says why few respondents will count none or all.
Includes a practice list and a private way to count.
Keeps a direct question on the same behavior and says the difference from the list estimate will be reported.
Does not calculate a sample size.

evals.name: Missing context
evals.prompt: Our survey self-reports look too good. Can you make a list experiment?
evals.expected_output: The skill asks for the behavior, the respondents and mode, and the affordable sample, and produces nothing else.
assertions: Asks which behavior, over what period, and why people would hide it.
Asks who the respondents are or how they are surveyed.
Asks how many respondents are affordable or whether the estimate is needed for subgroups.
Does not produce statements or a design.

evals.name: Near the escalation point
evals.prompt: We're working with the tax authority in Guatemala City on compliance letters to small businesses. We want to estimate what share of the businesses in our sample under-declare sales. Sample is 400 business owners, interviewed face to face in Spanish, most with secondary schooling. The tax authority will see the results by district. Design the list experiment please.
evals.expected_output: The skill says 400 respondents is too few for the method and that an ethics reviewer must decide whether to measure this at all, since results go to the tax authority by district.
assertions: Says a list estimate from 400 respondents would be noisier than a direct question, or that district estimates are out of reach.
Says a figure for a district could be used against the businesses surveyed even though no individual is identified.
Says what to bring to the specialist.
Does not present a design as ready to field.

evals.name: Wrong skill
evals.prompt: In our girls' education program in Amhara, Ethiopia, we want to know whether mothers think their neighbors approve of girls staying in school past 15. Can you write that as a list experiment?
evals.expected_output: The skill says the question is about what respondents believe others approve of, not their own hidden behavior, and points to the skill for that.
assertions: Says a list experiment estimates the respondents' own behavior or views, not what they expect of others.
Does not produce a list experiment design.
